items.title_kr: Macy's, Tommy Hilfiger 및 Donna Karan 등과 함께 2026 Fall fashion campaign 공개
items.title_en: Macy's Unveils Its 2026 Fall Fashion Campaign Featuring Major American Brands
items.body_kr: Macy's가 American fashion을 조명하는 새로운 Fall fashion campaign을 론칭하며 본격적인 seasonal merchandise 마케팅에 돌입했습니다. 주요 브랜드와의 Partnership을 통해 다가오는 Holiday season traffic과 sell-through를 견인할 전략입니다.
items.body_en: Macy's launched its new Fall fashion campaign celebrating American fashion featuring top brands. The initiative aims to drive traffic and merchandise sell-through heading into the peak Holiday season.

items.title_kr: Kohl's, Walmart 출신 Ryan M. Waymire를 새로운 Chief Merchandising Officer로 영입
items.title_en: Kohl’s Names Walmart Fashion Alum Ryan M. Waymire as Chief Merchandising Officer
items.body_kr: Kohl's가 Walmart의 fashion 임원 출신인 Ryan M. Waymire를 Chief Merchandising Officer로 임명했습니다. 이번 인사는 최근 부진한 실적 속에서 merchandise 전략을 재정비하고 customer retention을 강화하기 위한 조치입니다.
items.body_en: Kohl's has appointed former Walmart fashion executive Ryan M. Waymire as its new Chief Merchandising Officer. This leadership change aims to revamp its merchandise strategy and improve customer retention amidst ongoing retail challenges.

items.title_kr: Abercrombie & Fitch, Q2 record sales 달성… store 확장 및 리모델링 추진
items.title_en: Abercrombie & Fitch Posts Record Q2 Sales and Plans New Store Expansion
items.body_kr: Abercrombie & Fitch가 기록적인 Q2 sales를 기록하며 성장세를 이어갔으나, Hollister의 comparable sales는 소폭 하락했습니다. 회사는 견고한 브랜드 모멘텀을 바탕으로 offline store 확장과 리모델링 투자를 지속할 계획입니다.
items.body_en: Abercrombie & Fitch reported record Q2 sales while Hollister comparable sales saw a slight decline. The company plans to continue investing in offline store expansions and remodels building on its strong brand momentum.
